@@U04392@@
There they are, the same dark, ancient lindens, strong and sturdy as ever. And to think I’ve found them again after all these years of wandering! The same old place, the same old cottage where they took me in and tended my needs when tossed ashore on those sandy dunes by stormy waves! How I long to thank that brave, dear couple that came to my aid. But they were old even then. I wonder if they’re still here to welcome me now? What pious people they were! Shall I knock? Shall I call? Greetings to you in there if you're still here, still eager to find pleasure in doing good!

@@U04394@@
(A little, very old woman.)

@@U04395@@
Dear stranger! Gently! Gently! He’s sleeping, my husband. Softly! Let him sleep. He needs long rest for the short time he’s awake.

@@U04397@@
Is it really you, then, Mother? You, here, to receive my thanks, you and your ancient husband, who saved my young life so long ago?
translation:
@@U04392@@
它们就在那儿，同样的黑色、古老的椴树，一如既往地强壮而坚固。想想我在流浪了这么多年之后又找到了他们！同样的老地方，同样的老小屋，当我被暴风雨抛到沙丘上时，他们收留了我并照顾我的需要！我多么想感谢那对帮助我的勇敢、亲爱的夫妇。但即使那时他们也已经老了。我不知道他们现在还在这里欢迎我吗？他们是多么虔诚的人啊！我要敲门吗？我要打电话吗？如果你还在这里，仍然渴望从行善中找到乐趣，我向你问好！

@@U04394@@
（一个身材矮小、年纪很大的女人。）

@@U04395@@
亲爱的陌生人！轻轻地！轻轻地！他正在睡觉，我的丈夫。轻轻！让他睡吧。他在短暂的清醒时间内需要长时间的休息。

@@U04397@@
那么，妈妈，真的是你吗？你，在这里接受我的感谢，你和你的老丈夫，很久以前拯救了我年轻的生命？
